SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.user_id) FROM contest_users cu INNER JOIN users u ON cu.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'user' AND cu.start_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.user_id) FROM contest_users cu INNER JOIN users u ON cu.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'user' AND cu.submitted = TRUE

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contest_user_id) AS attemptCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_correct = TRUE THEN s.contest_user_id END) AS correctCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s.contest_user_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_correct = TRUE THEN s.contest_user_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT s.contest_user_id), 2) ELSE 0 END AS correctRate FROM questions q LEFT JOIN categories c ON q.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN submissions s ON q.id = s.question_id WHERE q.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY q.id, q.title, c.name ORDER BY q.order_num ASC

WITH category_info AS ( SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.order_num AS order_num, COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS total_questions, COALESCE(SUM(q.points), 0) AS total_points FROM categories c LEFT JOIN questions q ON c.id = q.category_id AND q.is_active = TRUE WHERE c.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.order_num ), active_users AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cu.id AS contest_user_id FROM contest_users cu INNER JOIN users u ON cu.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'user' AND cu.start_time IS NOT NULL ), user_category_scores AS ( SELECT au.contest_user_id, ci.category_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_correct = TRUE THEN q.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS score FROM active_users au CROSS JOIN category_info ci LEFT JOIN questions q ON ci.category_id = q.category_id AND q.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN submissions s ON au.contest_user_id = s.contest_user_id AND q.id = s.question_id GROUP BY au.contest_user_id, ci.category_id ) SELECT ci.category_id AS categoryId, ci.category_name AS categoryName, ci.total_questions AS totalQuestions, ci.total_points AS totalPoints, COALESCE(AVG(ucs.score), 0) AS averageScore FROM category_info ci LEFT JOIN user_category_scores ucs ON ci.category_id = ucs.category_id GROUP BY ci.category_id, ci.category_name, ci.total_questions, ci.total_points, ci.order_num ORDER BY ci.order_num ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN correct_count = 0 THEN '0题' WHEN correct_count BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3题' WHEN correct_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '4-6题' WHEN correct_count BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '7-10题' ELSE '10题以上' END AS range, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT cu.id, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS correct_count FROM contest_users cu INNER JOIN users u ON cu.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN submissions s ON cu.id = s.contest_user_id WHERE u.role = 'user' AND cu.start_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cu.id ) AS user_progress GROUP BY CASE WHEN correct_count = 0 THEN '0题' WHEN correct_count BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3题' WHEN correct_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '4-6题' WHEN correct_count BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN '7-10题' ELSE '10题以上' END ORDER BY MIN(correct_count)
